property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always reverts if any external call to caddress.transferFrom(...) reverts (i.e., transfer propagates callee failures); the mutant that removes require(_s) allows transfer to succeed even when a callee call reverts, violating this property for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) after the external call so a failed call does not revert, changing whether transfer reverts depending on callee success.
